niche: auto detailing (interior & exterior, mobile service available)

has_own_site_evidence: Google Business Profile lists 'Add website' (no website on file); their one real link is a tropikdetailing.square.site booking page (booking platform, does not count as own domain per pipeline rules). A third-party SEO aggregator (auto-detailing-2vk.pages.dev) claims a domain 'tropikdetailingtampa.com', but that domain was checked directly from this session (curl via the egress proxy, both http and https, with and without www) and returned no DNS record at all (proxy diagnostic: 'the host is allowed for this session, but the egress proxy could not connect to it... the name has no public DNS record or the host is down'), confirming the aggregator's claim is unverifiable/false. Conclusion: has_own_site = false.
email_search_note: No public email found. Checked: Google Business Profile (phone only), WebSearch for the business name plus 'email contact Mason', the square.site booking page (JS-rendered, no visible contact info extractable), and no Facebook/Instagram profile located to check an About section. Phone is the only real public contact channel; outreach registered as pending_manual.

services.pricing_note: No price list found publicly or on the square.site booking page (JS-rendered, not scrapeable from this session). Site uses the adapted variant: every detail is quoted, call for a price, nothing invented.
